messages:
sam.lee: hi all — first week q: I need to verify a payments flow in staging and also pull audit logs from the console for the test run. who can grant me staging admin + log download? :wave:
priya: hey @sam, welcome! you can get staging admin for a short window. infra-ops handles the role assignment. for logs, security requires an approval ticket before exporting PII-containing audits.
sam.lee: understood. is there a checklist or template for that approval?
priya: yep — use the 'Access & Audit Export' template in JIRA. include env, resources, retention plan, and who will have the export. tag @security.
onboarding-bot: welcome @sam.lee! onboarding checklist items pending: staging console access, audit-export training. Link: https://intranet.redwood/onboard-checklist :tada:
infra-ops: @sam, sending a temporary role 'console-staging-admin' for 48h. you should see an invite; you'll be in the 'console-audit-readers' group too. note: role grants UI toggles and read/export of non-sensitive audit fields only.
sam.lee: got the invite and can toggle flags, but when I try to download 'audit-2026-03-20.csv' I get a modal warning about PII. it won't let me export.
security: exporting audits with potential user identifiers requires a signed export request. please fill the form in the jira ticket you opened and attach a data minimization plan. we'll review within 2 business hours.
sam.lee: filed JIRA ENG-ONBOARD-1301 with the template, included test plan and retention = 24h. added @priya and @security as watchers.
priya: thanks — p.s. when toggling flags for tests, prefer using a canary group so prod-like telemetry isn't skewed. use 'X-Operator' header in API calls to surface the operator in logs.
sam.lee: can you paste an example curl for the flag canary?
priya: sure:
```
TOKEN=$(op get token console-service)
curl -X POST https://console.staging.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/patch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Operator: sam.lee" \
  -d '{"flag":"payments.new_flow","targets":[{"segment":"onboard_canary","value":true}]}'
```
sam.lee: thanks — using a service token. question: do I create a short-lived service token or use personal token?
infra-ops: create a short-lived token scoped to 'flags:write' via the console -> API keys -> Create -> TTL 2h. avoid personal long-lived tokens. CI should use workspace-level service tokens stored in Secrets.
sam.lee: export request approved now. security: any special steps to scrub PII after export?
security: yes — run the scrub script in infra-tools before uploading to S3. link: https://infra.redwood/tools/scrub. mark the S3 object with tag 'onboard-test' and retention 24h.
sam.lee: ran the toggle, executed smoke tests, pulled telemetry, scrubbed the export, and uploaded to S3. Closing ENG-ONBOARD-1301. all good! :white_check_mark:
priya: awesome — please add a one-line note in the onboarding doc about the audit export flow so future hires know the steps.
onboarding-bot: congrats on completing staging access tasks, @sam.lee! :confetti_ball:
